text:
Anna (runtime): Heads-up — planning to apply the engine shim + quant profile tweak tonight at 22:00 UTC. It's a non-disruptive rollout but we need a deploy owner and a smoke-check owner. Can folks volunteer?

Devon: I can own the deploy window. I'll be around for the whole 22:00–23:30 UTC window.

Maria: PR #4827 was merged earlier, confirm it includes the fallback-model routing change? https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4827 :eyes:

Anna (runtime): Yes — PR includes the fallback variant flag and the model-tag mapping. Good catch.

Sam: Quick note — there was a flaky e2e in kv-cache warming in staging earlier. I fixed a test timeout in the branch but let's watch warm-up metrics closely.

Devon: Good call. For smoke owner I'll run the latency and error-rate checks and shadow traffic validation. Need someone to run the perf token-cost sanity and kv cache logs.

Lee: I'll collect the kernel-level traces and enable debug for 15m after the first canary. Add the flag `runtime.trace.kernel=1` and `trace.sampler=0.01` in the deploy job.

ops-oncall: Please make sure rollback runbook is up-to-date. If p95 latency > 2x baseline or error-rate > 1%, we trigger rollback. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/infrarunbooks/rollbacks

Anna (runtime): Rollback owner? We should have someone ready to flip traffic to the last-good model variant and revert the quant profile.

Maria: I can own rollback steps and coordinate with platform on the traffic switch.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window for `engine-shim-update-2026-03-17` at 2026-03-17 22:00 UTC. Created canaries: 3 nodes / 5% traffic for 10m.

Devon: Plan for checks (short checklist):
- canary pass: p50/p95 within 10% of baseline
- error-rate <= baseline + 0.5%
- KV-cache hit ratio doesn't drop > 5%
- token cost regression <= 3%
- no memory OOM logs in kernel traces

Sam: For quick smoke commands, use this:`bash
# run latency smoke against canary set
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-api.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"hello world","max_tokens":64}' | jq '.latency, .error'
`

Lee: Kernel trace snippet to watch (`/var/log/runtime/kernel-trace.log`):
```
[2026-03-17T22:05:12Z] kernel: kv_cache_warm: hit_rate=0.87 slot_alloc=0.01 mem_used_mb=12432
[2026-03-17T22:05:18Z] kernel: quant_walk: qtype=fp16->int8 profile=qp-v2.4 time_ms=12
```

Anna (runtime): If canary looks good after 15m we'll ramp by 20% every 10m until 100% with health gates. If any gate fails, Maria executes rollback and Devon pauses further ramps.

Devon: I'll post short updates in this thread during the rollout. If I don't post within the first 8m after canary, ping me @devon (mobile).

Maria: Confirming I have the rollback playbook and contact to platform-ops. I'll prepare a short checklist to flip the variant and revert quant profile:
1) set model-routing:variant=stable-2026-03-10
2) apply quant profile: qp-active=qp-v2.3
3) scale canaries down to 0
4) monitor for stabilization 10m

Devon: All right — owners assigned. I'll start the deploy at 22:00 UTC and run the canary checks. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Anna (runtime): Thanks team. Leaving notes for postmortem/observability: attach the prompt set we used and token-cost snapshot. Maria/MigrationOwner, please keep a short timeline in the ticket.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary nodes healthy (3/3).

Devon: Canary metrics look stable at +1% p95, error-rate +0.1%. Proceeding to 25% ramp in 5m.

Sam: Observed no regression in kv-cache hit ratio so far.

Maria: Standing by for rollback, ready to cut traffic if needed.

Devon: Ramp to 25% done. Next check in 10m.

[end of thread]
